correctness.rationale: An exact exponential labeled-tree SET decomposition yields \(F_t=ze^{T-F}\) and \(F=\log(1+tT)\). Marking all root incident edges gives the explicitly normalized bivariate EGF A(z,q). Differentiation gives \(H=T\log(1+T)-\tfrac12\log^2(1+T)\); the edge identity \(B_n=n-1-\sum_{v\in I_n}\deg(v)\) is pathwise because the greedy set is independent. Dominant-square-root singularity transfer proves the finite correction \(-9/16+\log2/8\), and coefficient transfer with the two-root local limit proves the empirical degree law and convergence. Exactly 38 rational-exact checks passed across n=2..7 and direct order enumeration n=2..6. Computation supports, not replaces, the proof.

value.rationale: On a greedy independent set, edges not incident to a selected vertex link two rejected vertices. Their count is a natural geometric measure of jamming unobservable from the selected-set cardinality alone. The all-order root-degree joint law and explicit order-one finite-size correction resolve this meaningful graph-geometric statistic and provide degree-conditioned occupancy observables, not an ad hoc finite slice.
